description: This file defines the DefaultDirectoryGrain class, which implements the IDefaultDirectoryGrain interface and extends the Grain class. It includes methods for pinging, resetting a counter, retrieving runtime identity, and proxy pinging another grain.

classes.name: DefaultDirectoryGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing directory-related functionalities, including ping, reset, and identity retrieval.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Increments the internal counter and returns its value asynchronously.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal counter to zero asynchronously.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Returns the runtime identity of the grain asynchronously.

methods.name: ProxyPing
methods.description: Calls the Ping method on another grain implementing ICommonDirectoryGrain.
